name: hakka-cdp-playwright-example
description: Playwright E2E test that captures a page's real network traffic via hakka-cli/cdp and asserts on it.
//overrides: hakka-cli isn't published yet, so it's a file: dep here and the transitive trio it depends on (hakka-core, hakka-bridge, hakka-node) is overridden to the same directories. This example lives outside the root npm workspace on purpose (packages/* only matches one level deep) so it resolves hakka-cli/cdp exactly the way an outside consumer would. Install with npm — bun lays file: deps out as per-file symlinks, which the exports map's 'source' condition doesn't follow the same way npm's does.
